title: EmbeddingsCollection
description: Schema structure mapping text document embeddings to support ticket metadata inside Vector DB (e.g. Qdrant / ChromaDB).

id.description: Unique embedding identifier (typically matches the raw tweet_id).

vector.description: Numerical vector embeddings generated using the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model (dimension: 384).

document.description: Cleaned customer complaint text used to generate the embedding.
